verdict.rationale: LocalAI documents a distributed mode where GPU worker nodes self-register with a frontend coordinator and scale horizontally. That amounts to spreading inference load across multiple GPU machines, roughly data-parallel scaling. The evidence never mentions tensor or pipeline parallelism, nor splitting a single model across GPUs. Missing for 10: tensor-parallel support, pipeline-parallel support, multi-GPU within a single node, configuration docs for parallelism strategy, independent or hands-on corroboration.
